scientific_integrity: The proof is finite but exhaustive: a deterministic 670-pair acyclic discrete-Morse matching, exact zero integral Morse attaching vector, and independent finite-field boundary calculations; all critical definitions and scripts are self-contained.
scientific_limitations: Exact integral homotopy is proved for the single sixteen-vertex rook graph only; no all-rectangles or equivariant classification. Publication priority is best-knowledge and not independently certified.
title: Ninety-eight three-spheres and one four-sphere in the four-by-four rook general-position complex
